name: Medrazerhof
beschreibung: The Medrazerhof is situated in a quiet location in Fulpmes, a municipality in the Stubaital. The surroundings are characterized by the alpine landscape and offer direct access to hiking trails as well as the ski areas of the Stubaier Gletscher. The amenities include comfortable rooms with bathroom, balcony and some with mountain views, as well as a wellness area with sauna. The style of the accommodation is traditional and down-to-earth, tailored to a relaxing vacation in the mountains. The property primarily caters to active holidaymakers and families who appreciate nature and exercise. The associated restaurant serves regional dishes and typical Tiroler specialties.
